method: GF+ adaptive per-row format selection on REAL trained weights
key_finding: GF+A picks INT in 99.8% of rows at all widths. Float pockets never win on real weights with per-row scaling. NF4 wins 2.2% of rows at 4-bit but GF+A header overhead negates the gain.
honest_limitation: This confirms MSE-level finding but does NOT measure downstream BPB. QAT may behave differently. Also: φ-rule float pockets never selected = φ-rule is not useful when per-row scaling is already applied.
